title: Status properties/TickingWithSource
html:
See also Status properties.

TickingWithSource is a status property. An effect with this property will "tick" (i.e. apply its effects and reduce its remaining duration by 1 turn) on the turn of the condition's source. Normally, this would happen on the affected creature's turn instead. For example, a target affected by  Spirit Guardians (which has the TickingWithSource property) will take damage on the caster's turn, while a target affected by  Burning (which does not have the property) will take damage on its turn.

This property is also particularly important for some 1 turn duration effects like  Bone Chilled or  Ray of Frost. Without this property, these effects would tick down at the start of the target's turn, ending immediately without applying the debuff for even a single turn.

List of conditions with TickingWithSource

Condition Effects
Abjure Enemy: Frightened
  • The affected creature cannot move. Frightened creatures also have  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Attack Rolls.
Aegis of the Absolute
  • The Netherbrain is Immune to all types of damage it took in the previous round until the start of its next turn.
Animalistic Vitality
  • Affected entity regains 2d8⁠⁠Hit Points of health every round when below 60 HP. It also receives an additional 3.5 m (12 ft) of movement speed. [See: Bugs]
Bhaalist Ritual Target
  • As part of the challenge to enter the temple, the affected entity has become the target of a chanting cultist, the Farslayer, who can cast  Bhaal's Power Word Kill once its profane ritual ends. Exiting the Farslayer's chanting range of 55 m (183 ft) makes you invulnerable to the effect. Slaying the Farslayer stops the ritual and wins the conflict.
Bone Chilled
  • Can not regain  hit points.
  • Cannot help  Downed characters.
  • If Undead, has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls.
Brittle
  • Affected entity has been rapidly cooled while aflame, making it Vulnerable to Thunder and Bludgeoning damage.
  • Takes 2d6⁠⁠Cold damage at the start of their turn.
Chain of Tyranny
  • Affected entity has only half its movement speed. When the chain breaks, it takes 8d8⁠⁠Force damage.
Constricted
  • Affected entity can't move.  Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while its attack rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
  • The entity takes 2d6+2⁠⁠Piercing and 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic per turn.
  • Can be removed by  Help.
Curse of the Dire Raven
  • Marked by the feather of a dire raven.  Attack Rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage.
Cursed: Additional Damage
  • Receives an additional 1d8⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster's attacks or spells.
Cursed: Attack Disadvantage
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls against the source of the curse.
Cursed: Charisma
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Charisma.
Cursed: Constitution
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Constitution.
Cursed: Dexterity
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Dexterity.
Cursed: Intelligence
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Intelligence.
Cursed: Strength
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Strength.
Cursed: Wisdom
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Wisdom.
Deadly Orders
  • Affected entity was ordered to attack a specific enemy.
  • It is more likely to target this enemy, and Attack Rolls against the enemy have  Advantage.
Devoured Intellect
  • Intelligence has been reduced by 1 per turn.
Distracted

Not paying any attention to their surroundings.

The distractor's allies have  Advantage on their next Attack Roll against the creature.

Exploding Flumph
  • This spirit will explode at the end of the turn. Each creature within 2 m (7 ft) must succeed a Dexterity  Saving Throw or take 1d6⁠⁠Force.
Explosion Imminent!
  • The freezing sphere will explode, casting  Otiluke's Freezing Sphere.
Exposing Bite
  • Creature is distracted. The next attack against the creature from within 2 m (7 ft) is guaranteed to be a critical hit.
Frightened
  • The affected creature cannot move. Frightened creatures also have  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Attack Rolls.
Grappled
  • Affected entity is incapacitated and cannot be damaged while held within the grapple.  Help it to free it!
Grappled
  • Affected entity is incapacitated and cannot be damaged while held within the grapple.  Help it to free it!
Guiding Bolt
  • The next  Attack Roll made against this creature has  Advantage.
Heat Metal
  • Heats up a metal weapon or armour on a creature with no save (weapon is automatically prioritized).
  • Metal weapons are dropped if the creature holding it fails their initial  Saving Throw.
  • If the creature is touching the heated metal item, they receive  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
  • Each subsequent turn, if the creature is still touching the metal, the spellcaster can use  Reapply Heat Metal to deal another 2d8⁠⁠Fire damage, forcing the creature to pass a Saving Throw again or drop the item (if it is a metal weapon).
Heat Metal: Disadvantage
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and  Ability Checks until the start of the caster's next Turn.
Horde Breaker
  • Creature is open to a follow-up attack.
Hypnotic Gaze
  • Can't move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions.
  • Spellcaster has  Advantage on Ability Checks in dialogue.
  • Removed upon taking damage.
  • Duration can be extended with  Maintain Hypnotic Gaze
Hypnotised
  • Can't Move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.
  • Removed by taking damage, being Shoved, or Helped.
Lured
  • The affected entity is attracted to a harpy's luring melody and uses its turn to move closer to the harpy, possibly provoking opportunity attacks from the other harpies.
  • The affected entity must pass a  DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw at the start of their turn or remain lured.
  • Taking damage or being Shoved removes the condition.
Mobile Flourish Target
  • Targeted by a bard's fluid attack. The bard can teleport next to the creature.
Paranoid Dreams
  • When this Spectator is struck, it dreams in fear.
  • After 5 Paranoid Dreams, it will spend a Legendary Action to cast  Ocular Nightmare.
  • If the Spectator uses one of its Eye Rays, it loses one Paranoid Dream.
Prime Target
  • You have drawn Grym's ire.
  • Grym will attempt to attack this creature if possible.
Ray of Frost
  • Movement Speed is reduced by 3 m (10 ft).
Regeneration
  • The Wood Woad regains 10⁠⁠Hit Points if it walks through a vine surface, unless it recently took ⁠Fire damage.
Revitalising Gore
  • Affected entity is drenched in its enemies' blood. It regains 2d6⁠⁠Hit Points per turn.
  • At level 10, the healing is increased to 4d6⁠⁠Hit Points per turn.
Septic
  • Affected entity has its Constitution reduced by 1, and has  Disadvantage on Constitution  Saving Throws
Shredded Armour
  •  Armour Class has been reduced by 2.
  • Removed by healing.
Soulnumbed
  • Can't take  Bonus Actions or  Reactions.
Spirit Guardians
  • Spirits assail the affected entity, damaging it every turn and halving its movement speed.
  • Damage taken is 3d8⁠⁠Radiant or 3d8⁠⁠Necrotic plus 1d8 per upcast level.
  • Damage is halved on a successful  Wisdom Saving Throw.
Stricken with Eldritch Inertia
  • Affected entity has  Disadvantage on its next  Saving Throw against a spell cast by the source of the condition.
Surgeon's Chosen
  • Carrying the implement requested by the Surgeon to complete its surgery.
  • The nurse gains a +4 bonus to Armour Class.
True Strike
  • The spellcaster has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls against this creature.
Untenable Secret
  • Ravaged by a monstrous secret. Affected entity must cast  Share Untenable Secret on an ally or suffer debilitating ⁠Psychic damage.
Vampire Regeneration
  • The vampire regains  20 hit points at the start of its turn, unless it is in sunlight, or has taken radiant damage or damage from holy water.
Witch Bolt
  • The spellcaster can use an Action each turn to activate the arc linking it to this creature to automatically deal 1d12⁠⁠Lightning damage.
